> > Fact From Story: The play looked good, the Bears' defense looked better. It's Chicago's ball with favorable field position.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: When a team gets the ball on downs, they get it where the other team failed to convert.
> Commonsense Knowledge: If a team does not gain enough yards on fourth down, the other team gets the ball.
